review.note: M51: joined with algeria-fr, the same polity. The outlines either side of the 1885/1886 seam share 99.14% of the smaller (docs/m51-overlaps.md), and that seam is where Historical Basemaps stops and CShapes 2.0 starts, not a date. The interval is now the 1885 record's own start (1878) and the 1886 record's own end (1962); neither was authored here. Nothing else crossed: the merged record keeps its own names, summary and licence.

summary: Entity 615 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 4 periods of territorial validity, from 1886 to 1962. The source calls it "Algeria"; the names on this record are the ones data/imports/cshapes-actors.json gives it. Its last capital in the dataset is Algiers. The code is mapped onto more than one actor (data/imports/cshapes-actors.json); this record holds the periods before the first cut. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
